description: Human escalation rules — when and how to escalate to human reviewers. Sourced from system_responsibility.md and review_taxonomy.yaml (CONF).

entries.title: Evidence insufficient → always escalate
entries.description: When evidence is insufficient to support the vulnerability classification, always escalate to human reviewer regardless of confidence score. This is an automatic escalation trigger.
conditions: OR evidence is absent or scanner-only
entries.action: Mandatory escalation to human reviewer (priority: High). Set human_escalation.required = true. recommended_reviewer = technical_reviewer.

entries.title: High/Critical severity with low confidence → always escalate
entries.description: When a finding is High or Critical severity but the confidence score is below 0.7, always escalate to human reviewer. High-impact uncertain findings must not be left to autonomous decision.
entries.action: Mandatory escalation to human reviewer (priority: Critical). recommended_reviewer = senior_pentester.

entries.title: Model and rule engine disagree → always escalate
entries.description: When the SLM classification and the rule-based engine classification disagree, always escalate to human reviewer. This disagreement indicates uncertainty that requires human judgment.
entries.action: Mandatory escalation to human reviewer (priority: High). Provide both classifications with rationale. recommended_reviewer = technical_reviewer.

entries.title: Overall confidence below threshold → conditional escalation
entries.description: When the overall confidence score is below 0.7, escalate to human reviewer. The threshold of 0.7 balances autonomous efficiency with safety.
entries.action: Conditional escalation to human reviewer. recommended_reviewer = technical_reviewer.

entries.title: Classification certainty below threshold → conditional escalation
entries.description: When classification certainty is below 0.6, the finding may be hard to classify. Escalate to human reviewer for classification judgment.
entries.action: Conditional escalation. recommended_reviewer = technical_reviewer. Provide all evidence for human classification.

entries.title: Sensitive data detected → escalate to data protection officer
entries.description: When sensitive data (credentials, PII, internal infrastructure details) is detected in the finding, escalate to the data protection officer. The finding must be redacted before further processing.
entries.action: Mandatory escalation to data protection officer (priority: Critical). Block further review until redaction is applied.
